paragraphs.text: And on the six days of the second week we brought, according to the word of God, unto Adam all the beasts, and all the cattle, and all the birds, and everything that moves on the earth, and everything that moves in the water, according to their kinds, and according to their types: the beasts on the first day; the cattle on the second day; the birds on the third day; and all that which moves on the earth on the fourth day; and that which moves in the water on the fifth And Adam named them all by their respective names, and as he called them, so was their And on these five days Adam saw all these, male and female, according to every kind the earth, but he was alone and found no helpmeet for him.
paragraphs.original: ወበዕለት፡ ሳድስት፡ ሰዱስ፡ ሳምንት፡ ካልእት፡ አምጻእነ፡ በቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ አዳም፡ ኵሎ፡ አራዊተ፡ ወኵሎ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወኵሎ፡ አዕዋፈ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወበበ፡ ምስሎሙ፡ አራዊተ፡ በዕለት፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ወእንስሳ፡ በዕለት፡ ካልእት፡ ወአዕዋፈ፡ በዕለት፡ ሣልስት፡ ወእለ፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ በዕለት፡ ራብዕት፡ ወእለ፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ በዕለት፡ ሐምስት፡ ወሰመዮሙ፡ አዳም፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ወዘሰመዮሙ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ኮነ፡ ስሞሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʿəlat sādəstə sədus sāmənt kāləʾt ʾamṣaʾəna ba-qāla ʾəgziʾabəḥēr ḫaba ʾAdām kwəlo ʾarāwita wa-kwəlo ʾənəssā wa-kwəlo ʾaʿwāfa wa-kwəlo za-yətḥawwas lāʿla mədr wa-kwəlo za-yətḥawwas wəsta māy baba zamadu wa-baba məslomu ʾarāwita ba-ʿəlat qadāmit wa-ʾənəssā ba-ʿəlat kāləʾt wa-ʾaʿwāfa ba-ʿəlat śāləstə wa-ʾəlla yətḥawwasu lāʿla mədr ba-ʿəlat rābəʿt wa-ʾəlla yətḥawwasu wəsta māy ba-ʿəlat ḥaməst wa-samayomu ʾAdām kwəlomu baba səmātihomu wa-zasamayomu ʾəmənnehu kona səmomu

paragraphs.text: And the Lord said unto us: good that the man should be alone: let us make a helpmeet for him.' And the Lord our God caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.
paragraphs.original: ወበአምስቱ፡ ዕለት፡ እሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ መጽኡ፡ ኀበ፡ አዳም፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ከመ፡ ይሰምዮሙ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወአሐደ፡ አሐደ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ወኮነ፡ አዳም፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘረከበ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾaməstu ʿəlat ʾəllu kwəlomu maṣʾu ḫaba ʾAdām ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom kama yəsammomu wa-konu kwəlomu baba zamadu wa-ʾaḥada ʾaḥada məsla bəʾəsitu məslēhu wa-kona ʾAdām bāḥtitu wa-ʾalbo zarakaba la-rəʾəsu məslēhu bəʾəsita

paragraphs.text: And He awaked Adam out of his sleep and on awaking he rose on the sixth day, and He brought her to him, and he knew her, and said unto her: 'This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called [my] wife; because she was taken from her husband.'
paragraphs.original: ወይቤለነ፡ እግዚእ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ሠናየ፡ ይኩን፡ ሰብእ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ንግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ዘይትከሐሎ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbēlana ʾəgziʾ ʾi-kona śannāya yəkun sabʾ bāḥtitu nəgbar lottu radāʾē za-yətkaḥalo

paragraphs.text: Therefore shall man and wife be one and therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and cleave unto his wife, and they In the first week was Adam created, and the rib -his wife: in the second week He showed her unto him: and for this reason the commandment was given to keep in their for a male seven days, and for a female twice seven days.
paragraphs.original: ወአንበሮ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክነ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ሰዊመ፡ ወንዋመ፡ ወሰከበ፡ ወአንቅሐ፡ እምነ፡ ንዋሙ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ዕለት፡ በወርኅ፡ ካልእ፡ ወቦአ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወአርአዮ፡ ወወፅአት፡ ብእሲት፡ ካልአዊት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanbaro ʾəgziʾ ʾamlākəna lāʿlēhu sawima wa-nəwāma wa-sakaba wa-ʾanqəḥa ʾəm-nəwāmu ba-sadus ʿəlat ba-warḫ kāləʾ wa-boʾa ḫabēhu wa-ʾarʾayo wa-waḍʾat bəʾəsit kāləʾāwit

paragraphs.text: And after Adam had completed forty days in the land where he had been created, we brought him into the garden of Eden to till and keep it, but his wife they brought in on the eightieth day, and after this she entered And for this reason the commandment is written on the heavenly tablets in regard to her that gives birth: 'if she bears a male, she shall remain in her uncleanness seven days according to the first week of days, and thirty and three days shall she remain in the blood of her purifying, and she shall not touch any hallowed thing, nor enter into the sanctuary, until she accomplishes these days which (are enjoined) in the case of a male child.
paragraphs.original: ወአውፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ እምነ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ ዐጽመ፡ አሐደ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ብእሲት፡ እምዐጽሙ፡ ወመንበረ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወመንበረ፡ አምሳለ፡ አዳም፡ ወወሀበ፡ ሎቱ፡ መጻተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ፍጽፅረ፡ ለርእሱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾawḍəʾa lottu ʾəm-nə gabawātihu ʿaṣma ʾaḥada wa-wəʾtu bəʾəsit ʾəm-ʿaṣmu wa-manbara śəgāhu wa-manbara ʾamsāla ʾAdām wa-wahaba lottu maṣṣata śəgāhu fəṣəṣəra la-rəʾəsu

paragraphs.text: But in the case of a female child she shall remain in her uncleanness two weeks of days, according to the first two weeks, and in the blood of her purification, and they will be in all eighty days.' And when she had completed these eighty days we brought her into the garden of Eden, for it is holier than all the earth besides and every tree that is planted in it is holy.
paragraphs.original: ወአንቅሐ፡ አዳም፡ እምነ፡ ንዋሙ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ወርእየ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ወይቤ፡ ነየ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዐጽም፡ እምነ፡ ዐጽምየ፡ ወይእቲ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምነ፡ ሥጋየ፡ እንተ፡ ትሰመይ፡ ብእሲት፡ እስመ፡ እምነ፡ ምታ፡ ተወስደት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanqəḥa ʾAdām ʾəm-nə nəwāmu wa-ʾansəʾa wa-rəʾəya bəʾəsita məslēhu qərruba wa-yəbē naya yəʾəti ʿaṣəm ʾəm-nə ʿaṣəməya wa-yəʾəti śəgā ʾəm-nə śəgāya ʾənta təssammay bəʾəsit ʾəsma ʾəm-nə mətā tawəsdat

paragraphs.text: Therefore, there was ordained regarding her who bears a male or a female child the statute of those days that she should touch no hallowed thing, enter into the sanctuary until these days for the male or female child are accomplished.
paragraphs.original: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይኀድግ፡ ብእሲ፡ አባሁ፡ ወእሞ፡ ወይትሌጠ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ወይከውኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ሥጋ፡ አሐደ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəḫadəg bəʾəsi ʾabbāhu wa-ʾəmmo wa-yətlēṭa məsla bəʾəsitu wa-yəkawwənu kwəlomu śəgā ʾaḥada

paragraphs.text: This is the law and testimony which was written down for Israel, in order that they should observe And in the first week of the first jubilee, [1-7 A.M.] Adam and his wife were in the garden of Eden for seven years tilling and keeping it, and we gave him work and we instructed him to do everything that is suitable for tillage.
paragraphs.original: በሳምንት፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ተፈጥረ፡ አዳም፡ ወወገንዱ፡ መሳርየ፡ ወበሳምንት፡ ካልእ፡ አርአያ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለመትኒ፡ እስመ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ለትትፈለጥ፡ ብእሲት፡ እምነ፡ ምታ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዕለታተ፡ በዘወልደት፡ ተባዕተ፡ ወወልደት፡ አንስተ፡ ሰማንየ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ኢትትፈለጥ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ እስከ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ ሎሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ እሉ፡ በከመ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ለትባዕት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ወለአንስት፡ ስሳ፡ ዕለታተ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-sāmənt qadāmit tafaṭra ʾAdām wa-waganədu masāriya wa-ba-sāmənt kāləʾ ʾarʾayā lottu la-matni ʾəsma la-zəntu taʾazaza la-tətfalaṭ bəʾəsit ʾəm-nə mətā sabʿa ʿəlatāta ba-zawaldat tabāʿta wa-waldat ʾanəsta samānya wa-ʾənza ʾi-tətfalaṭ bēta maqdas ʾəska yətfēṣṣam lomu mawāʿəl ʾəllu ba-kama taʾazaza la-tbāʿt śalāsā ʿəlatāta wa-la-ʾanəst səssā ʿəlatāta

paragraphs.text: And he tilled (the garden), and was naked and knew it not, and was not ashamed, and he protected the garden from the birds and beasts and cattle, and gathered its fruit, and eat, and put aside the residue for himself and for his wife [and put aside that And after the completion of the seven years, which he had completed there, seven years exactly, [8 A.M.] and in the second month, on the seventeenth day (of the month), the serpent came and approached the woman, and the serpent said to the woman, 'Hath God commanded you, saying, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?'
paragraphs.original: ወእምድኅረ፡ አርብዓ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለአዳም፡ ጊዜ፡ ፈጸመ፡ አንሰ፡ አምጻእነ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ከመ፡ ይትገበር፡ ወይዕቅባ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ በሰማንያ፡ ዕለት፡ አምጻእናሃ፡ ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ቦአት፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra ʾarbəʿā ʿəlatāt la-ʾAdām gizē faṣṣama ʾanəsa ʾamṣaʾəna kiyāhu wəsta ganata ʾEdom kama yətgabbar wa-yəʿqəbā wa-bəʾəsitu ba-samānya ʿəlat ʾamṣaʾənāhā wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə boʾat wəsta ganata ʾEdom

paragraphs.text: And she said to it, 'Of all the fruit of the trees of the garden God hath said unto us, Eat; but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden God hath said unto us, Ye shall not eat thereof, neither shall ye touch it, lest And the serpent said unto the woman, 'Ye shall not surely die: for God doth know that on the day ye shall eat thereof, your eyes will be opened, and ye will be as gods, and ye will know And the woman saw the tree that it was agreeable and pleasant to the eye, and was good for food, and she took thereof and eat.
paragraphs.original: ወበእንተዝ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በበ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ለዘወለደት፡ ለእንተ፡ ወለደት፡ ተባዕተ፡ ለትንበር፡ በርኵሰ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ወከመ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታት፡ ወካዕበ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለትንበር፡ በደመ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ወአልባቲ፡ ትግባእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥሙረ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ኢትባእ፡ እስከ፡ ይትፌጸሙ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ እለ፡ ለተባዕት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾəntazə taʾazaza lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy baba ʿəlatāta la-zawaladat la-ʾənta waladat tabāʿta la-tnabbar ba-rəkwsa sabʿa ʿəlatāta wa-kama śalāsā ʿəlatāt wa-kāʿba śalāsā ʿəlatāt la-tnabbar ba-dama nəṣḥa wa-ʾalbāti təgbāʾ kwəlo śmura qəddusa wa-wəsta bēta maqdas ʾi-təbāʾ ʾəska yətfēṣṣamu zəntu mawāʿəl ʾəllu la-tabāʿt

paragraphs.text: And when she had first covered her shame with figleaves, she gave thereof to Adam and he eat, and his eyes were opened, and he saw And he took figleaves and sewed (them) together, and made an apron for ,covered his shame.
paragraphs.original: ወዘወለደት፡ አንስተ፡ ለትንበር፡ በርኵሰ፡ ሰማንየ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ሰሙናት፡ ክልኤ፡ ወወልደ፡ አምሳለ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ሰዳሳ፡ ወሰዱስ፡ ዕለታት፡ በደመ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ወይከውን፡ ሰማንየ፡ ዕለታት፡ ኵሉ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zawaladat ʾanəsta la-tnabbar ba-rəkwsa samānya ʿəlatāta samunāt kələʾē wa-walda ʾamsāla qadāmi sadāsā wa-sadus ʿəlatāt ba-dama nəṣḥa wa-yəkawwən samānya ʿəlatāt kwəlu məsla kāləʾu

paragraphs.text: And God cursed the serpent, and was wroth with it for ever . . And He was wroth with the woman, because she harkened to the voice of the serpent, and did eat; and He said unto her: 'I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy pains: in sorrow thou shalt children, and thy return shall be unto thy husband, and he will rule over thee.'
paragraphs.original: ወእምድኅረ፡ ፈጸመት፡ ዘንተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ንጽሐ፡ አምጻእናሃ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስመ፡ ቅድስት፡ ይእቲ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተቴሁ፡ ይትከሰት፡ ቅዱስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra faṣṣamat zanta mawāʿəla nəṣḥa ʾamṣaʾənāhā wəsta ganata ʾEdom ʾəsma qəddəst yəʾəti ʾəm-nə kwəlu mədr wa-kwəlu ʿəḍ za-wəstatēhu yətkaśśat qəddusa

paragraphs.text: Adam also he said, ' Because thou hast harkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree of which I commanded thee that thou shouldst not eat thereof, cursed be the ground for thy sake: thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to thee, and thou shalt eat thy bread in the sweat of thy face, till thou returnest to the earth from whence thou wast taken; for earth thou art, and unto And He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them the Garden of Eden.
paragraphs.original: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ለዘወለደት፡ ለትባዕት፡ ወለአንስት፡ በበ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትጋነኒ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ቅድስት፡ ለእግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza śərʿat la-zawaladat la-tabāʿt wa-la-ʾanəst baba mawāʿəlihomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat kama ʾi-yətgāneni bēta maqdas zawəsta mədr ʾənta qəddəst la-ʾəgziʾ

paragraphs.text: And on that day on which Adam went forth from the Garden, he offered as a sweet savour an offering, frankincense, galbanum, and stacte, and spices in the morning with the rising of the sun from the day when he covered his shame.
paragraphs.original: ወካዕበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘያረኵስ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ መስተዋቅሕ፡ ለሞት፡ በከመ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥርዐት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kāʿba kwəlu zayāraqəs bēta maqdas mastawāqəḥ la-mot ba-kama ṣəḥuf wəsta śərʿat

paragraphs.text: And on that day was closed the mouth of all beasts, and of cattle, and of birds, and of whatever walks, and of whatever moves, so that they could no longer speak: for they had all spoken one with another with one lip and with one tongue.
paragraphs.original: ወይነብር፡ አዳም፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዓመተ፡ ለሰቢረ፡ ምድር፡ ወዕቀብታ፡ ወወሀብናሁ፡ ግብረ፡ ወመሀርናሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ግቢሮተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yənabbər ʾAdām ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom sabʿa ʿāmata la-sabira mədr wa-ʿəqabtā wa-wahabnāhu gəbra wa-maharnāhu kwəlo gəbra zayəkawwən gəbirota

paragraphs.text: And He sent out of the Garden of Eden all flesh that was in the Garden of Eden, and all flesh was scattered according to its kinds, and according to its types unto the places which had And to Adam alone did He give (the wherewithal) to cover his shame, of all On this account, it is prescribed on the heavenly tablets as touching all those who know the judgment of the law, that they should cover their shame, and should not uncover themselves as the Gentiles uncover themselves.
paragraphs.original: ወይትገበር፡ ግብረ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ ትከይዶ፡ ወይከውና፡ ለትሕነጹ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətgabbar gəbra wa-bəʾəsitu təkayyədo wa-yəkawwənā la-tḥənaḍḍu məslēhu ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom

paragraphs.text: And on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and forth from the Garden of Eden, and they dwelt in the land of Elda in the land of their Adam called the name of his wife Eve. And they had no son till the first jubilee, [8 A.M.] and after this he Now he tilled the land as he had been instructed in the Garden of Eden.
